lines.text: The Holy Spirit told the church at Antioch to set apart Barnabas and Saul, so they fasted, prayed, and laid hands on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sailed from Seleucia to Crete and proclaimed God's word in Salamis synagogues.
On Cyprus they found the sorcerer Bar-Jesus at Paphos, and the proconsul Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's word.
Elymas opposed them, so Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, said Elymas would be blind for a time, and darkness fell.
When the proconsul saw what happened, he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord and became afraid.
